purpose: Test whether two mappings with equal read counts, activities and marginal decoded-error distributions can differ in reconstructed arithmetic error after group calibration.
calibration: Both policies receive the true full-group current deviation. Test conditional-mean subtraction and full-group gain normalization separately.
